description:
intent=i012 snapshot=s01 branch=nonlinear-linear-assume status=complete
finding location=net/batman-adv/routing.c:950-963 confidence=medium conclusion=batadv_recv_unicast_packet dereferences skb->data as a struct header before any pull in this function; only the 2-byte entry pull covers byte 0, so the pattern matches the branch but the concrete OOB is bounded - report as medium-confidence hypothesis.
finding location=net/batman-adv/routing.c:664-673 confidence=medium conclusion=batadv_route_unicast_packet reads ttl/dest after callers pulled >=10 bytes, so the reads are guarded; only the pattern (pre-pull struct deref) matches the branch - low actionable value, kept for the record as medium-confidence variant of the same pattern.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/ was only pattern-sampled (CAN/arcnet/ethernet driver casts of skb->data are TX-path or driver-local linear buffers); the ~2900-file tree was not exhaustively audited for receive parsers lacking pulls.
coverage_gap=Protocols building skbs in driver-owned linear memory (CAN, arcnet, ATM lane) were assumed linear by construction; no per-driver verification of skb_headlen was done.
coverage_gap=mac80211/wpa/tkip/wep and lib80211 skb->data header casts were not individually audited; mac80211 rx paths mostly linearize via ieee80211_data_to_8023 but this was not verified line-by-line.
limitation=No build, KASAN run, or reproducer was possible (read-only snapshot, no network); all conclusions rest on static reading of the exact supplied lines.
limitation=The primary finding (batadv_recv_unicast_packet) is a pattern match where the concrete dereferenced byte (packet_type at offset 0) lies within the 2-byte pskb_may_pull performed by the entry dispatcher, so an actual out-of-bounds read was not established; it is reported as a medium-confidence hypothesis per the branch definition.
limitation=Whether received batman-adv skbs can actually be non-linear at batadv_batman_skb_recv depends on the underlying hard-interface driver's SG/GRO configuration, which is deployment-dependent and unverified.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied.
